amazon-connector.title: Multi-Channel Fulfillment
amazon-connector.text: ship orders from your other channels (WooCommerce, Shopify, Odoo eCommerce, sales orders) from your FBA stock, with tracking back in Odoo.

amazon-connector.title: FBA inbound shipments
amazon-connector.text: plan and send shipments to Amazon fulfillment centres from Odoo, with box labels, carriers, tracking and received quantity checks.

amazon-connector.title: Removal orders and FBA stock adjustments
amazon-connector.text: return or dispose of FBA stock from Odoo, and apply Amazon's inventory adjustments to the FBA warehouse.

amazon-connector.title: Invoice upload
amazon-connector.text: send the Odoo invoice PDF of each order to Amazon, so buyers download it from their Amazon account.

amazon-connector.title: Variations and more images in List on Amazon
amazon-connector.text: list products with sizes and colours as one Amazon family, with all product images.

amazon-connector.title: Amazon shipping labels
amazon-connector.text: Easy Ship and Buy Shipping labels for FBM orders, printed from the delivery order.

amazon-connector.title: Real-time orders and profit per order
amazon-connector.text: Amazon notifications instead of polling, and a profit report per order with Amazon fees and costs.
